The exact association of the two cabinet-door closing motions at approximately frames 312 and 320 is mildly ambiguous because of the close viewpoint and hand occlusion; the left door appears to close first.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens the upper drawers on each side of the stove, and later closes all four parts.
